decisions.rationale: Reframed as LLM chat-based meta-learning (free) — success/failure analysis + assertive-comms tips.

decisions.title: Supabase as primary DB + backend

decisions.title: LangChain ReAct agent
decisions.rationale: Replaced by serverless 5-context router + free-first LLM.

decisions.rationale: Out of new spec scope; LLM meta-learning instead. Archived as optional module.

decisions.title: Supabase Edge Functions replace Celery workers

decisions.title: Free-first complexity LLM routing
decisions.rationale: Ollama (free, default) → DeepSeek API (medium) → Claude API ONLY on explicit admin request for heavy analysis/reports. Routine chat, matching and summarization cost zero Claude tokens.

decisions.title: Serverless 5-context conversational router
decisions.rationale: Classify WhatsApp messages into Ventas, Compras, Trámites, Inquilinos, IA-meta. Derive Trámites/Inquilinos to dedicated personal WhatsApp numbers.

decisions.title: Secret-key scheduler (GitHub Actions / Cron-Job.org)
decisions.rationale: Scheduled jobs hit secret-key-protected Edge Functions. Replaces Celery Beat. No self-hosted workers.

decisions.title: No external web access
decisions.rationale: No web search/scraping. Only fetch a consulted listing URL to verify it is a property. Adinco scraper removed.

decisions.title: Deprecate legacy FastAPI/Celery/Redis stack
decisions.rationale: backend/, gateway/ (legacy), docker-compose celery/redis/postgres to be removed (TD-006/TD-007).

decisions.title: Interlinked-business logic (oferta/demanda cross-match)
decisions.rationale: Each party has an OFERTA (a property they own/list) and/or a DEMANDA (search preference). An interlink between parties A and B holds when: opt1 = A.oferta satisfies B.demanda; opt2 = B.oferta satisfies A.demanda; opt3 = both (reciprocal). Matching is additive and free (pgvector, Ollama embeddings, zero Claude). A property-seed sweep covers all three (opt2 is opt1 seen from the counterpart property). F121 records ACTIVE interlinks; F122 records HIDDEN ones and discards actives.

decisions.title: Match rules & scoring (mandatory filters + affinity + permuta)
decisions.rationale: Deterministic, free (zero LLM). Mandatory filters exclude any offer that violates: budget (±10% margin), target zone (unless buyer allows zonas limítrofes), operation (buyer sees only venta or permuta-enabled). Affinity score 0-100 over m² closeness (40), ambientes/dormitorios (35), amenities (25), weights redistributed over available data. Permuta: score>75 with unmet non-mandatory reqs => 'Oportunidad de Ajuste Parcial'; permuta-enabled opt3 link => 'Posible Permuta Cruzada'. Output: list ordered high→low score with a per-property explanation for the human agent. pgvector stays the additive discovery layer; these rules are authoritative. Scoring reports data gaps + confidence; on low confidence due to missing data the system asks the involved advisor to complete it (P010, request-data-completion) rather than degrading silently. Impl: supabase/functions/_shared/match-scoring.ts.

decisions.title: Capture-docs escalation (advisor first, then martillero)
decisions.rationale: The bot requests capture documentation from the ADVISOR first (never the owner directly). After 3 failed/overdue asks it notifies the martillero and asks whether the bot should request it directly. If the martillero authorizes, the bot requests it (from the owner); if still not received, it notifies the martillero to take measures. State machine: asesor -> await_martillero -> bot -> measures -> done. Impl: supabase/functions/capture-docs/index.ts; fields in migration 14.

decisions.title: Configurable monthly goals (captaciones/ventas/alquileres)
decisions.rationale: Per-advisor monthly targets configurable by admin and martillero in their panel: agency defaults in app_settings (goal_captaciones_mes/goal_ventas_mes/goal_alquileres_mes), per-advisor overrides in advisor_goals (migration 15). Advisor reports show actuals vs team average AND vs goal, stating how close/far from the objective the advisor is. Closed-deal actuals now come from the operations table (D025), not a proxy. Impl: supabase/functions/goals/index.ts (get/set) + advisor-report. Martillero write access lands with M4 RBAC.

decisions.title: Deal closing lifecycle
decisions.rationale: Closing: VENTA closes when the client reserved AND the reservation was accepted (stage reserva_aceptada); ALQUILER closes when reserved (stage reserva_confirmada). Lifecycle: visita -> post_visita (bot asks how the visit went) -> sigue | descartado(lost) -> reunion_reserva -> reserva_confirmada -> (venta) reserva_aceptada -> won. End-of-day scheduler asks reservation confirmation then acceptance (followups). Impl: supabase/functions/operations/index.ts + _shared/followups.ts; table migration 16. Advisor ventas/alquileres counts derive from operations.status='won' (exact).
